Divyanka pens emotional post as building guard dies in fire, shares his video blessing her kids 
 Menu English हिन्दी Categories For the best experience use inshorts app on your smartphone Divyanka pens emotional post as building guard dies in fire, shares his video blessing her kids
 short by Ankit Tiwari / 08:52 am on Tuesday, 10 November, 2026 Actor Divyanka Tripathi mourned the loss of her building guard after a fire in her residential building on Diwali Eve. "When we brought our babies home...one of the first people to...bless them was our beloved Dhanpat Uncle," she said. "You were never just the guard of our building...You were part of our everyday lives...We will miss you deeply," she added. read more at Hindustan Inshorts Pte. Ltd.
